verdict.rationale: Drata publishes a structured, OpenAPI-based v2 API reference at developers.drata.com/openapi/reference/v2, organized by tag with per-endpoint pages (Personnel, Controls, Policies, Custom Connections, Monitoring Tests, and others). The evidence never shows that this reference is interactive, has a try-it console, or offers runnable code samples. Probes also found no openapi.json at the common paths, so the spec cannot be fetched to drive runnable tooling. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it/runnable request console, code examples per endpoint, a downloadable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration.
